info.title: Geoapify Routing API
info.description: Calculate routes for driving, walking, cycling, trucking, and public transit.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

get.description:
Calculates a route through two or more ordered waypoints.

- Provide each waypoint as `latitude,longitude`; separate waypoints with `|`.
- `waypoints` and `mode` are required. The example uses passenger-car routing (`mode=drive`).
- The default `geojson` response contains route geometry, distance, travel time, legs, steps, and turn-by-turn instructions.
- Use `format=json` for a plain JSON result or `format=xml` for XML.

**Example:** `waypoints=43.424923,-123.298537|43.261954,-123.350676|43.120223,-123.398972&mode=drive`

parameters.name: waypoints
parameters.description: Ordered route points. Use `latitude,longitude` for each point (latitude from -90 to 90; longitude from -180 to 180) and separate points with `|`. At least two waypoints are required.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Travel profile used to calculate speeds, access rules, and road restrictions. `drive` represents a passenger car.

parameters.name: intermediate_waypoint_mode
parameters.description: Treatment of intermediate waypoints. `stopover` splits the route into independent legs; `through_stop` splits it into legs while preserving travel direction; `pass_through` treats it as a via point without creating a new leg.

parameters.name: optimize_stops
parameters.description: Whether to optimize the order of intermediate waypoints. The first and last waypoints remain fixed.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Route preference. `balanced` balances time and distance; `short` prioritizes distance; `less_maneuvers` penalizes turns and is supported only for motorized road modes.

parameters.name: units
parameters.description: Unit system for distances in the response. `metric` returns meters; `imperial` returns miles.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language code for human-readable turn-by-turn instructions.

parameters.name: avoid
parameters.description: Road features, locations, polygons, or countries to avoid. Separate multiple rules with `|`. An optional importance from 0 to 1 can follow road-feature rules, for example `tolls:0.8`.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Additional result data. `instruction_details` adds maneuver metadata; `route_details` adds road attributes; `elevation` adds the elevation profile; `admin_areas` adds country and state metadata and administrative area crossings. `polyline5` and `polyline6` add encoded geometry to the route properties and every leg without replacing the GeoJSON geometry. The route-level value concatenates legs in travel order and removes a duplicated shared endpoint. `route_details` and `elevation` increase API credit cost and are unavailable for transit modes; encoded polylines do not add credits.

parameters.name: traffic
parameters.description: Traffic model for motorized modes. `free_flow` assumes uncongested roads; `approximated` reduces speeds on roads likely to be congested.

parameters.name: max_speed
parameters.description: Maximum speed for driving, truck, and bus modes. Use 10 to 252 km/h with `units=metric`, or 6.5 to 155 mph with `units=imperial`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response representation. `geojson` returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection; `json` returns route objects with `{lon, lat}` geometry points; `xml` returns the JSON structure serialized as XML.

200.description: Calculated route with geometry, distance, travel time, legs, steps, and navigation instructions.

400.description: Invalid routing parameters or a distance between consecutive waypoints that exceeds the limit for the selected travel mode.

routeTooLong.description: Regular API calls allow up to 100 km per consecutive waypoint pair for `walk` and `hike`; asynchronous batch calls allow up to 200 km.

value.message: Too long distance between locations. Distance should not exceed 100000 meters for a regular API call, and 200000 meters for an asynchronous batch API call. Estimated distance is 250000 meter(s).

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

polyline5.description: Precision-5 encoded geometry for the leg. Present when `details=polyline5` is requested.

polyline6.description: Precision-6 encoded geometry for the leg. Present when `details=polyline6` is requested.

polyline5.description: Precision-5 encoded geometry for the complete route. Present when `details=polyline5` is requested.

polyline6.description: Precision-6 encoded geometry for the complete route. Present when `details=polyline6` is requested.

polyline5.description: Precision-5 encoded geometry for the complete route. Present when `details=polyline5` is requested.

polyline6.description: Precision-6 encoded geometry for the complete route. Present when `details=polyline6` is requested.

ApiKeyInQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyInQuery.description: Geoapify API key query parameter. Recommended authentication method for public APIs. API keys in URLs can be logged; use x-api-key for server-to-server clients.

ApiKeyInHeader.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyInHeader.description: Geoapify API key header. Supported as an alternative authentication method for public APIs.
